# Support

If you need help with the Vision Condition Visualizer or the VisionSim GitHub Action:

- **Email**: hello@theblind.spot
- **GitHub Issues**: [Open an issue](https://github.com/bloo-berries/blindness-visualizer/issues)
- **Security vulnerabilities**: Please report privately via [Security Advisories](https://github.com/bloo-berries/blindness-visualizer/security/advisories/new) or email hello@theblind.spot. Do **not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

## VisionSim GitHub Action

For help with the GitHub Action, include the following in your issue:

- Your workflow YAML (redact any secrets)
- The full action log output
- The conditions and intensity you configured
- Whether the PR is from a fork
